description: The number of citations to works that have been tagged with this topic. Or less formally: the number of citations to this topic.
name: cited_by_count

description: The date this Topic object was created in the OpenAlex dataset, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. Example: 2017-08-08
name: created_date

description: A description of this topic, generated by AI.
name: description

description: The English-language label of the topic. Example: scientometrics and bibliometrics research
name: display_name

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the domain. Example: https://openalex.org/domains/1

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the domain. Possible values: Life Sciences | Social Sciences | Physical Sciences | Health Sciences

name: domain
description: The ID and the name (display_name) for the domain of this topic. The domain is the highest level in the domain, field, subfield, topic system, which means it is the least granular.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the field. Example: https://openalex.org/fields/17

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the field. Example: Computer Science, Medicine

name: field
description: The ID and the name (display_name) for the field of this topic. The field is the second-highest level in the domain, field, subfield, topic system, which means it is the second-least granular.
The OpenAlex ID for this topic. Example: https://openalex.org/T10102
name: id

fields.name: openalex
fields.description: The OpenAlex ID, same as id. Example: https://openalex.org/T10102

name: ids
description: External identifiers OpenAlex holds for this topic. IDs are expressed as URIs where possible.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the subfield. Example: https://openalex.org/subfields/1710

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the subfield. Example: Information Systems

name: subfield
description: The ID and the name (display_name) for the subfield of this topic. The subfield is the third-highest level in the domain, field, subfield, topic system, which means it is the third-least granular.

The last time anything in this topic object changed, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. This date is updated for any change at all, including increases in various counts. Example: 2026-10-12T05:31:44.211000
name: updated_date

description: The number of works tagged with this topic.
name: works_count
keywords

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the keyword. Example: https://openalex.org/keywords/bibliometrics

fields.name: score
fields.description: Relevance score of the keyword for this topic. Example: 0.83

description: Keywords that characterise this topic (objects; the old STRING[] column was dropped on load because the snapshot delivers objects).

name: legacy_keywords
description: Keywords for this topic as plain strings, in the format used before keywords became objects. Example: ["Citation Analysis", "Bibliometrics"]

name: siblings

fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the sibling topic. Example: https://openalex.org/T...

description: Other topics in the same subfield.
